# Symbols Nerd Font

`SymbolsNerdFont-Regular.ttf` is from [Nerd Fonts](https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts) v3.5.0
(`nerd-fonts.symbols-only` in nixpkgs). Nerd Fonts patcher and font are MIT licensed; the bundled
icon sets keep their own licenses (Material Design Icons: Apache 2.0; Codicons: CC BY 4.0;
Font Awesome: OFL 1.1; Octicons: MIT). Pane renders all of its icons from this font as text.
